products.title: Sofa - G02 - Miami Soft - By Paola Navone
products.description_html:
The Miami Soft modular sofa adds a touch of extra comfort to the freedom of Paola Navone's outsize design, embodying Baxter's masterful ability to make leather extra-soft. The informal, versatile and welcoming character of this large modular sofa focuses all of its attention on the comfort of its guests. Placed in the centre of the living room, it invites you to take a seat on your favourite side with a simple movement of the roller backrests, facilitating complete relaxation or conversation depending on the situation.

DIMENTSIONS: 

W. 300 cm | D. 108 cm | H. 80 cm

products.title: Sofa - Narciso - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Like in the legend of Narcissus, Narciso is the irresistible surprise one encounters in a reflection. Studiopepe's collection of outdoor chaise-lounge, modular sofa and armchair has comfortable profiles made vaguely irregular by the addition of big soft cushions, perfect for relaxing on in any season, which seem to be held together by the discreet and essential presence of a steel band. This cosy outdoor sofa can be composed according to individual tastes and requirements by adding chaises lounge, corner elements and comfortable poufs. Elegance, comfort and pure indulgence.

products.title: Sofa  - So Soft - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: So Soft is an ottoman and dormeuse collection that celebrates the comfortable side of living. Conceived by Studiopepe, the two rounded accessories enhance the space with new opportunities for comfort and socialising, in a vision of the living room as an inviting, relaxing place. This impression is accentuated by the leather upholstery, enhanced by the sinuous embrace of the metal tubular elements that contain its shapes. Here, ottomans and daybeds are reassuring oases, cosy refuges for taking a break, alone or in company.

products.title: Sofa - Himba - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Himba collection redefines interiors and exteriors with ethnic-inspired and natural looking furniture. Sofas, loungers and armchairs designed by Roberto Lazzeroni to become majestic presences in the home as well as in the garden, blending into nature and acquiring character and meaning over time. Remarkably delicate and made even more welcoming by the cushions, the pieces in the collection are like exotic sculptures and can be used both in the living room and outside the home thanks to the leather (indoor or outdoor) and fabric (outdoor) covers.

products.title: Sofa - Ginestra - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Antonino Sciortino’s Ginestra chaise longue is an original symbol of everyday living, dividing the living space with the graphic play of its striking frame. Made entirely of galvanized metal rod and painted matte black, the sofa features a rhythmic pattern that alternates full and empty, curved and severe shapes. The key design element of the chaise longue is the high vertical backrest that embraces and supports the leather-upholstered cushioned seat. The decorative profile of the seat cushion draws soft shapes and wins you over with Ginestra’s unique comfort.

products.title: Sofa - Chester Moon - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The sofa and armchair of the Baxter Chester Moon collection are born from a reinterpretation of the classic Chesterfield, the most iconic and beloved of upholstered furniture models, today as yesterday. Paola Navone's sophisticated design combines balanced forms, distinctive features of any Chesterfield, with the complex techniques used to craft the product. From the unique workmanship of the quilted leather, with the continuous tufting on all surfaces, to the painstaking attention paid to each button, the devil of this particular concept is in the detail. The Chester Moon sofa and armchair revisit the past in terms of the classic techniques involved in their creation, but also reveal a quest for minimalism in the cleanliness of their lines which, soft and rounded, promote a completely new living experience.

products.title: Sofa - Freud - By Baxter
products.description_html: With its minimalist, sophisticated design, the Freud leather bench designed by Baxter becomes the star of the space and assumes the characteristics of a versatile, timeless accessory. At once a bench, chaise longue and relaxing dormeuse, Freud adapts to the uses and circumstances of life, guaranteeing maximum comfort thanks to the option to add a soft roller headrest cushion secured by the leather belt. The raw-cut stitching of the upholstery accentuates the padding of the large upper cushion and lends a unique elegance to the structure’s sleek design.

products.title: Sofa - Fold - By Vincenzo De Cotiis
products.description_html: A masterpiece by Vincenzo De Cotiis, the Fold sofa takes its name from the captivating play of folds in the leather that envelops it, creating a distinctive texture with powerful visual impact. This unique element turns the surface into a tactile landscape—an expression of refined craftsmanship and aesthetic exploration. The shape is soft, enveloping and minimalist, containing in its purity traces of the long process of upholstery manufacture. The solid antiqued brass feet that support the sofa’s low frame are only present at the front, emphasising the unique and sophisticated style of a piece that elevates any space in which it is placed. Fold is not merely a sofa; it is a sculptural presence that transforms its surroundings—a contemporary design piece that enriches the space with its quiet elegance and unmistakable personality.

products.title: Sofa - Damasco - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Destructured and oversized, featuring a soft, rounded shape, Paola Navone’s Damasco sectional sofa moves away from the traditional image of an upholstered leather sofa through simplified forms and a relaxed, extra-comfortable design. Formed of upholstered modules with extra-large volumes, the seat is large, comfortable and enveloping. Whether an ottoman, dormeuse or love seat, each sofa module features leather upholstery stitched with the typical raw cut, a distinctive detail of the designer’s projects, which elevates its tactile and informal appearance.

products.title: Sofa - Clara- By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Commanding centre stage in the domestic setting, the Clara leather sofa by Christophe Delcourt is a modular piece that can transform the living room into an ever-changing and enjoyably versatile creative experience. A modular leather sofa which, through the combination of numerous elements, can be used to create different seating arrangements every time: joints, solids and voids, concave and convex curves for a dynamic and constantly evolving living room.

products.title: Sofa - Chicago- By Paola Navone
products.description_html: An exclusive creation by Paola Navone, the Chicago sofa redefines the very essence of contemporary relaxation. Its generously rounded forms create a haven of sophisticated comfort — where surrendering to stillness becomes a complete sensorial experience.Every curve is designed to cradle the body in a protective embrace, while the delicate stitching — with its subtle interplay of tensions — enhances the sense of infinite softness. The Baxter leather, selected for its exceptional quality, adapts with effortless elegance to the sofa’s sinuous shape — breathing and evolving over time with use. This design piece becomes the heart of the living space: an island of pure wellbeing where time gently slows. Chicago is more than a piece of furniture — it is a statement of style that transforms the living space into a multisensory experience of true comfort.

products.title: Sofa - Casablanca - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, the Casablanca sofa stands out for its simple and minimalist forms, for its soft and rounded lines that urge you to treat yourselves and surrender to its cosy embrace. Impressive in size, this leather upholstered sofa immediately catches the eye and becomes the absolute centrepiece of the living room. The generous cushions formed by the folds of the armrests and backrest, which can be positioned as desired, are pure temptation and the common thread that runs through the Casablanca collection. For resting, reading, meditating and dreaming, but also for enjoying a movie, this majestic sofa is designed for moments of total relaxation and adds style and originality to any room.

products.title: Sofa - Budapest Soft- By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Budapest Soft is a cosy leather sofa that stands out for its clean and simple design, emblematic of the elegant comfort that characterises Baxter upholstered furniture. Paola Navone designs a model with majestic dimensions that immediately becomes the focal point of the living room. The seat is wide and enveloping, made even more welcoming by the possibility of adding big soft cushions in which to sink. The details make the difference: the raw-edge stitching, the soft leather and the ability to compose your preferred shape make Budapest Soft a sofa that is as exclusive as it is versatile, a model that catches the eye and tempts you to indulge in a moment of carefree relaxation.

products.title: Sofa - Budapest - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A timeless icon is born from simplicity. The Budapest sofa, the first designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, represents the elegance of minimalism, of a linear and modular design that provides almost unexpected comfort. The rigid shell contains the large, enveloping seat cushions, limited by volumes that are only rigorous in appearance. The feeling of comfort is enhanced by the addition of ottomans and soft decorative cushions. The stitching details of the leather upholstery give the Budapest sofa a feeling of sophisticated naturalness, making it the centrepiece of any room.

products.title: Sofa - Brigitte - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: A generous design and maximum comfort: the Brigitte sofa and armchair collection by Draga Aurel revives the 1970s styles typical of the design studio to create two iconic additions, distinguished by their large size and extreme comfort. The extra-padded cushions of the large seat are upholstered in soft leather and supported by two curvy and comfortable shaped side armrests, making Brigitte the ideal sofa for indulging in moments of leisure and relaxation.

products.title: Sofa - Bergere Longe - By Baxter
products.description_html: With the Bergère Longe collection, Baxter celebrates timeless elegance with an armchair and sofa that combine comfort and sophistication. The leather upholstered seat and backrest cushions cradle you with a soft and inviting embrace. The wooden feet, offered in various finishes, enhance the design with an elegant natural feel, complemented by a decorative profile in matching leather that can be customised with other shades from the catalogue. The Bergère Longe collection stands out as an invitation to relax, seamlessly fitting into any setting owing to its superb balance of timeless design and contemporary touches.

products.title: Sofa - Aura - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: From the creative vision of Hannes Peer comes Aura, a modular leather sofa that transforms the living space with its unmistakable essential elegance, evoking the luminous, refined charm of Californian architecture. Its suspended base, refined and multifunctional, supports generous cushions with fluid elegance—offering a seating experience defined by uncompromising comfort. Aura invites personalisation through ever-changing configurations, adapting effortlessly to different needs—whether intimate or convivial. A perfect balance between a bold, steel-accented structure and the sinuous lines of its modular components makes Aura a design piece that stands out without overwhelming the space. It becomes an island of comfort, redefining the very notion of contemporary relaxation.

products.title: Sofa - Anais - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: With its minimalist, sophisticated design, the Anais armchair and ottoman collection expresses all the discreet, vintage-inspired 1970s elegance typical of Draga&Aurel products. The formal precision of the refined chair, which rests on a solid metal base, is softened by the enveloping, upholstered embrace of the backrest. Featuring a shape distinguished by its austere comfort, Anais invites you to take a break on one of the square or circular seats of the three ottomans, highly versatile elements that can enhance any environment and context. From the living room to the wardrobe and bedroom.

products.title: Sofa - Alfred - By Marco Milisich
products.description_html: Designed by Marco Milisich, the Alfred leather sofa is a project with an iconic soul, breaking away from the classic rules of upholstered furniture and acquiring, over time, all the charm of a time-worn piece. Alfred’s unique character can be appreciated above all in its original vintage version, where the special technique of giving the leather an antique finish lends it a unique appearance, making each piece irreplaceable and increasingly distinctive as time passes.

products.title: Sofa - Adel - By Baxter
products.description_html: Baxter’s Adel collection reworks the concept of a bench and ottoman with a completely original twist, creating an interplay of sinuous contours that join and follow each other in a harmonious rhythm of curves. The design of the ottoman and bench has an unusual but highly versatile character, offering novel design ideas both within a living room – as social seating – and as support elements that can enhance art galleries and installations.

products.title: Sofa - Lido - By Hannes Wettstein
products.description_html:
Hannes Wettstein conceives an armchair and a sofa with balanced and classical forms, of great softness and comfort but with a Nordic rigor.
Available in fibre or feather seats, and a completely removable leather or fabric upholstery.

products.title: Sofa - Chelsea - By Rodolfo Dordoni
products.description_html:
The Chelsea collection, designed by Rodolfo Dordoni in 2014, is enriched with three new items: a sofa and an armchair, both featuring snug backrests, and a bench. All three items are designed to create a cosy corner in a large living room, a special space in which to chat and relax. The solid wood frame and clean-cut geometric lines are complemented by the fluid line of the backrests, ensuring a comfortable and refined seat.

Each individual component of the Chelsea collection expresses the value of the traditional expertise that has gone into crafting top-quality raw materials, from the wood to the textiles and leather, with a passionate attention to detail, which gives these extremely versatile items a particular charm.

products.title: Sofa - Breeze - By Matteo Nunziati
products.description_html:
Breeze, a compact sofa with an eye-catching line, an appropriate choice to furnish either small city homes or imposing public spaces such as lobbies of big international hotels.
The construction choices have a recognisable image. The feet have essential but strong lines. There is a continuous seat without cushions with a sinuous and comfortable armrest.

products.title: Sofa - SKIN - By Jean Nouvel
products.description_html:
A texture crossed by light and suspended in space.
The result of many years of collaboration between Jean Nouvel and Molteni&C, SKiN is a self supporting hide leather cover with a special pattern. Leather without body reshapes itself over time so that innovation and memory hold the same form.

products.title: Sofa - Chelsea - By Rodolfo Dordoni
products.description_html:
With the Chelsea sofa, Rodolfo Dordoni extends his idea of comfort from the dining room to the living area.
Solid wood structure, enveloping seat, large cushions in goose down, is a contemporary reassessment of the most elegant reading or meditation bergere.

products.title: Sofa - Lucio - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Due Foglie Sofa from our Heritage catalog emerges as a highlight of 2024, paying homage to historic design figure Gio Ponti. This piece takes inspiration from Ponti’s stunning design for Villa Planchart in Caracas, commissioned in 1954 by Anala and Armando Planchart, ardent admirers of Ponti’s diverse talents. The sofa, one of the villa's iconic features, now takes center stage in the 2024 Collection under the name D.157.6, it’s current title in the Gio Ponti Archive.

Our project began with an examination of materials and technical specifications to not only ensure faithful adherence to the original design but also to the enduring quality that characterizes all Molteni&C products. 

The distinctive silhouette of the D.157.6 loveseat, originally named Due Foglie due to its seamless curvilinear shape reminiscent of a pod and two elongated leaves, is supported by a delicate trestle structure with a metallic finish. The defining feature of the loveseat is undeniably the foam structure, specially shaped by two molds. Beyond its striking aesthetic, this feature offers a unique seating experience: spacious and comfortable for one, yet conducive to the intimate conversations or quiet moments of two.

Allowing for the rare personalization of such a legendary piece, designer Marta Ferri has curated a wide selection of fabrics and leathers chosen specifically for both their visual appeal and performance abilities. Reviving the charm of a bygone era, the D.157.6 sofa exudes timeless elegance and transcends passing trends.

The Gio Ponti archive, a wellspring of inspiration, continues to inform Molteni&C's style, blending historical values with a forward-looking perspective. As we celebrate our prestigious 90-year milestone, the D.157.6 sofa epitomizes a lifestyle that spans generations and continents.

products.title: Sofa - D.157.6  - Due Foglie - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:

products.title: Sofa - Reversi ’14 - By Studio Hannes Wettstein
products.description_html:
Reversi ’14, design Studio HannesWettstein: Stephan Huerlemann e Simon Husslein, a modular, linear sofa which builds on previous experience in a project that keeps pace with current trends.
A demand for more softness, wide armrests, and high-tech padding. The seating depth is adjustable thanks to the movement of the backrest mechanism, and allows you to create, both a workspace and a welcoming relaxing space in a single sofa.

products.title: Sofa - Albert - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The new seating system reflects the Molteni&C corporate profile, based on two key words: tradition and technology, linked by the leitmotif of perfectly clean lines. A flexible and dynamic seating system, rich in content, which shows how research and craftsmanship have always been part and parcel of the company’s DNA. Albert is a brave step forward in the search for a seating system conceived as a flexible and disarticulatable structure, that can reshape the new complexity of modern living, marked by extreme planning.

The basic feature is that all the component parts, each with their own formal and functional autonomy, have been designed as parts of different spaces and different functions. Large parts in two depths, 105 and 150cm, available in several lengths, fitted with special cushioning that enables the depth of the ergonomic seat to be varied.

The tailoring is exasperated, the frames are all “marked” by these double seams that exalt the forms; the back cushion, conceived as a quilted blanket lying over the back of the seat, helps the shoulders to find a perfectly ergonomic seat. The various pouffs, of different sizes, reflect the refined workmanship and fit in harmoniously with the seating.

The base is not just a simple passe-partout, but the frame of the rounded profiles that sinuously accompanies the shape of the Pewter finishing on the floor, raising the seating and providing a floating and extremely lightweight effect. A complete and calibrated collection with perfect aesthetic balance, refinement and versatility. Albert can be upholstered in textiles or leathers chosen from the rich and varied Molteni&C collection.

products.title: Sofa - Surf - By Yabu Pushelberg
products.description_html:
Canadians George Yabu and Glenn Pushelberg, all-round players in the world of architecture, design and graphics since 1980, have just designed Surf, a modular sofa system, for Molteni&C, after making their debut with Dada, in 2006, with the futuristic Lisola design. Thanks to their experience in the hospitality field and in exploring the nature of organic forms well beyond any traditional approach, Yabu Pushelberg design seating, unfettered by the constrictions of excessive modularity and rich in unexpected details. Ideal for residential or hospitality projects, such as hotels or offices.

Seats all-one with the base, with rounded forms supporting snug, slightly protruding backrests, are the features that make Surf a design that is not only ergonomically perfect but also visually appealing.

This excellent result is due to the use of differentiated polyurethane foam technology. Artfully designed rectilinear, chaise longue, corner and terminal elements, partially devoid of backrests, give rise to multiple compositions suitable for situations of all kinds, maintaining in each the freshness and originality of the design.

A wide choice of textiles and leathers, chosen from the Molteni&C collection, further enhance Surf’s uniqueness. Surf is also an elegant little “dumb waiter” table, from the marble base and the wooden top complete with a small handle for moving it easily, it is perfect for keeping anything within easy reach when ensconced in a comfy sofa.

products.title: Sofa - Gregor - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Vincent van Duysen continues his research into the world of contemporary living by designing this Gregor modular system for Molteni&C.

Gregor comes complete with differentiated functional solutions.

It includes various straight, corner or peninsular units that can be mixed and matched together to give multiple combinations for a living space destined for conversation, reading and entertainment, with all the media devices readily available.

The multiple features underline the overall lightness of the design.

Gregor is a sofa collection playing subtlety with low proportions, thicknesses and a mix of refined materials.

products.title: Sofa - Octave - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Designed by Vincent Van Duysen, Octave is a system of modular sofas featuring rigorous shapes.

The source of Vincent Van Duysen’s inspiration for his new project are those wide skyscraper windows that offer breathtaking views over cosmopolitan megacities while comfortably seated on inviting sofas and armchairs.

Blade-like extruded steel legs support the base on which rest low rectangular textile or leather upholstered backrests, of the same thickness as the cosy seat cushions.

Octave offers open elements with which to create chaises longues or poufs that can be arranged alongside the composition or used as free-standing elements, also for the centre of the room.

products.title: Sofa - Marteen - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Marteen is a multifunctional seating and storage system introducing harmony with perfectly balanced volumes, in an alternation of solids and voids.

A new way of experiencing conviviality that satisfies the most dynamic interpretations of space, in full awareness of the continuous evolution taking place in the world of living.

The infinite possibilities of the Marteen sofa are revealed in the creation of versatile compositions - from the classic corner solution to the most modern island solutions - thanks to the combination of the various elements, including seats and storage units.

Destined to become a classic, the Marteen is characterised by a strong modern personality that elegantly responds to its intended function. Back cushions that can be arranged freely on the seat provide additional comfort and allow for different relaxing positions. The system is kept suspended from the ground by a pewter-coloured blade foot, ensuring greater momentum in compositions.

The armrest element defines the design and gives rhythm to the structure, acting both as a support point and as a container with hidden compartments for storing objects. The upper part, also in eucalyptus wood or the new thermo oak wood, contrasts with the lower part in pewter.

The modular system is distinguished by its end module, which can be upholstered in fabric or leather, with backrests and low and high armrests, enriched by wood or lacquered storage units.

products.title: Sofa - Paul - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Paul is a set of elegantly proportioned sofas with reassuring lines, elements that emphasize Vincent Van Duysen’s expressive rationality. The project includes linear sofas, angular compositions, chaises longues and islands, all with a single seat cushion.

Paul New Eco is a set of elegantly proportioned sofas that embody Vincent Van Duysen’s expressive rationality, now taking a significant leap towards environmental responsibility with the introduction of the recycled and biodegradable polyester fiber, Primaloft Bio.

This updated project includes linear sofas, angular compositions, chaise longues, and islands, all characterized by a single seat cushion and a eco-friendly and sustainable design. Imagined exclusively for the Paul sofa system, New Eco is designed to return to nature, offering a holistic solution for product wear and eventual end of life.

The Paul New Eco series is further elevated by the inclusion of the Reflect textile, a collaborative creation with Kvadrat, skillfully designed by Patricia Urquiola. With its refined diagonal pattern and a palette of 23 colors derived from 100% recycled PET bottles, Reflect exemplifies our dedication to sustainability without compromising on style or quality. Moreover, the manufacturing process of this fabric minimizes energy consumption, chemical usage, and CO2 emissions, setting a new standard for environmentally conscious design.

Paul New Eco features generous dimensions, distinctive double seams, and exceptional comfort, elements that create harmony even when placed in the center of the room. The impression is lightweight, accentuated by the neat design of the pressure die-cast aluminum feet.

Fabrics used in the upholstery production do not contain azoic colorants production, ensuring a responsible choice for well-being and the environment. Available in two depths, 100cm and 120cm, each element is meticulously crafted to ensure comfortable seating that exudes a welcoming and sophisticated ambiance in any environment.

Paul features generous dimensions, distinctive double seams and great comfort, elements that look good, even in the center of the room. The impression is lightweight, accentuated by the neat design of the pressure die-cast aluminum feet. Items featuring considerable depth complete the project, for a comfortable, luxurious and cosy way of sitting.

products.title: Sofa - Augusto - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
If home is the heart of daily life, the Augusto sofa is where one finds home. The evolution of luxury continues as creative director Vincent Van Duysen transforms the prior iteration of Augusto into a versatile modular system, blending timelessness with contemporary flair. In a way only he can, Van Duysen aims to further capture the enduring essence of Augusto through modularity, introducing innovative curvilinear pieces that foster connection.

Retaining its classic aesthetic, the 2024 Augusto sofa embodies the welcoming spirit of Molteni&C, offering both comfort and sophistication. The modular system includes lateral and central elements for enhanced functionality, and chaise lounges and islands as relaxation zones. From compact spaces to spacious rooms, Augusto provides stylish solutions tailored to diverse needs.

Augusto is available in a range of Molteni&C fabrics curated by designer Marta Ferri, with specially designed options available including classic leather finishes and innovative vegetable-tanned leather crafted from olive residue, accented by either matching leather or grosgrain fabric piping.

The various elements of the Augusto sofa combine to create a haven for both relaxation and interaction. The lateral, central, curvilinear, and island elements each measure to a depth of 100cm, while the chaise lounge boasts a depth of 160cm.

The Augusto sofa, by Belgian designer Vincent Van Duysen, is an exploration of contrasts: where past meets present and technical innovation meets the expert craftsmanship of Molteni&C.

The key to Augusto’s timeless aesthetic is the balance of soft, upholstered seats with the sophistication of its modern metal structure, creating a uniquely harmonious design that blends seamlessly with a multitude of environments. To enhance Augusto's unique silhouette, elegant piping runs along the cushions, defining their shape.

In conceiving the Augusto sofa, Van Duysen started with the idea of total comfort. He examined precisely the way the body would sink into its voluminous seat, recline into its cushioned backrest, or simply lean on its elegant, square-shaped armrests. Only once these factors were determined did he begin forming the shape, which incorporates a flush metal base that runs around the perimeter of the sofa emphasizing its volume and making it appear almost weightless.

Augusto represents a novelty compared to past Molteni&C collections: it is in fact a non-modular sofa, available in two depths - 100 cm and 116 cm and four configurations - 185, 205, 235, 270 cm - plus an element with a depth of 150 cm, offering maximum flexibility and versatility to adapt to any living space. The deeper element creates a chaise longue style seat.

products.title: Sofa - Turner - By Hannes Wettstein
products.description_html:
Formal moment or relaxing space? Turner, the seating system designed by Hannes Wettstein, combines comfort with refinement.
Settees in various sizes, corner pieces, chaises-longue and pouf can be combined together to create different furnishing solutions. Turner responds to varying needs in terms of comfort and posture, thanks to an easy mechanism which adjusts the depth of the seating.

Settees in various sizes, corner pieces, chaises-longue and pouf can be combined together to create different furnishing solutions.

Turner responds to varying needs in terms of comfort and posture, thanks to an easy mechanism which adjusts the depth of the seating.

products.title: Sofa - Cleo - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Cleo, a new design by the architect and creative director Vincent Van Duysen for Molteni&C, is a modular system consisting of various rectilinear, angular and self-standing elements that allow for a large number of compositions suitable for all kinds of living. The heart of the project is the frame, which is used for each individual component. A harmonious curvilinear shell, recalling a cosy place, which embraces seat and back without a break. The shell, upholstered in textiles or in leather, like the seat cushions, offers great comfort.

The possible combinations between the various upholstery materials for covering the frame and the seat cushions, can either make a contrast or emphasize the harmony of the two components. The rectangular back cushions can be placed at wilI to satisfy any requirements, guaranteeing comfort and allowing for different relaxation positions: from sitting comfortably to read a good book or spending time with loved ones, to lying down for a brief rest.

Cleo is supported by feet made of a thin layer of varnished steel, designed to make the sofa look like an object floating in the living area, thus become heart and protagonist, thanks to its easy collocation even in the centre of the room. In addition, Cleo has rectilinear single frame solutions, suitable for creating a sofa with complete and enveloping shapes.

The sofa collection Cleo is composed of different modules that allow a great variety of compositions. Cleo is characterized by a leather or fabric shell and base bestowing a sense of fluidity upon the object. The user can choose from a variety of leathers and fabrics for the backrest and seat to add a textured contrast. It is a very organic and comfortable sofa. A sofa on which to unplug and relax after a taxing day.

tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Organic in shape, upholstered in Pausa natural, and provided with a black base, Sofa Bernd matches with a myriad of interior styles and colour schemes, from minimalist to maximalist and from bohemian to eclectic.
This is the perfect spot for reclining.

products.title: Sofa - Björn L - Lyssa Sand
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The magnificent Sofa Björn L is a grand design that boasts an air of serenity and comfort.

In the enchanting Lyssa Sand shade perfectly complemented by a sleek black wooden base, this sofa invites you to unwind in its luxurious embrace. Indulge in the unparalleled comfort of the Sofa Björn L, where this masterpiece will be the focal point of your decor reflecting your exquisite taste.

Dimensions

Specifications

products.title: Sofa - F-Stripes
products.description_html: Representing Italian savoir-faire, the F-Stripes sofa subtly reveals iconic elements of Fendi's artisanal tradition. Its sleek, discreet shape is undoubtedly captivating; by looking closer one can appreciate all its distinctive details: the slender, tapering legs, its vertical elements finished with FF logo details and leather side bands inspired by Fendi's Selleria workmanship. Its neutral tones and logoed cushions create a welcoming atmosphere in the living area.

products.title: Sofa - Fendi F-Affair
products.description_html: The Fendi F-Affair sofa by Controvento is shaped on Fendi's iconic FF logo. Eclectic and playful, the modular seats fit intimately into each other, creating infinite design combinations and chromatic possibilities. A harmonious balance between concept and comfort translates into a versatile, welcoming seating solution.

products.title: Sofa - Five
products.description_html: A seamless dialogue between architecture and design, the Five sofa by Marcel Wanders is a harmoniously-balanced of seating and storage solution. Each padded modular seating unit is upholstered in a choice of fabric or leather, creating an elegant contrast of solids and voids with the marble side table and its push-pull drawer in varnished wood. A supremely versatile item of furniture with a host of configurations, it is designed to foster convivial living.

products.title: Sofa - Fun Fendi
products.description_html: The renowned Fendi artisanal heritage is expressed to perfection in this playful series of ultra-comfortable padded armchairs and sofas inspired by the iconic Peekaboo bag. Designed by Atelier Oï, each piece features fabric or leather upholstery with side slits offering glimpses of the padding for an original series of soft forms. The different pieces combine in a myriad of ways to create inviting compositions that can be arranged to suit the space and your mood.

products.title: Sofa - Gran Pliè
products.description_html: The Gran Plié seating collection by Thierry Lemaire consists of a series of two- and three-seater sofas and an inviting armchair. The visually light metal frame, which recalls the balletic plié position, embraces padded elements to create a pleasing harmony of soft curves. Ideal for both classic and contemporary decor schemes, each piece is a finely-calibrated balance of volumes designed for stylish comfort.

products.description_html: With its inviting form, the Parsifal round sofa is destined to become an irresistible magnet in your home as the place to live, socialise or simply relax. products.title: Sofa - Peekasit
products.description_html: The Peekasit seating project designed by Controvento, a spin-off of Studio Wanders and led by Gabriele Chiave, is inspired by Fendi's iconic Peekaboo bag. In a design that amazes with its pure and welcoming shapes, the fabric or sheepskin upholstery and the structure in fine Signoria leather create an original inside-out effect. The different elements combine in a compositional game with a strong visual impact, which amazes for its comfort and structural variety.

products.title: Sofa - Sohoft

The variety of modules offers interesting style opportunities with a distinctly contemporary touch, ranging from vis-à-vis seating to more articulated and expansive solutions.

products.title: Sofa - Taiko
products.description_html: The Taiko sofa, designed by Piero Lissoni, stands out for its generous volumes and deep, comfortable seating. Exuding personality, the piece has a linear, lightweight expression, underpinned by a modular design that will easily fit multiple landscapes. Refined finishing touches nod to Fendi's iconic leather craftsmanship – notice the interlaced micro-piping and FF motifs. Customisable cushions complete the design, giving life to a personal and luxurious concept of contemporary living.
